docket_entries.description: MONEY CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FOR $5,689.00 FILED BY TSAI, JEAN AS TO DEFENDANT POPLIN, KATIE ORDER SETTING TRIAL ISSUED FOR OCT-28-2020 AT 08:30 AM IN DEPT 506
PROOF OF SERVICE FILED ON CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF - FEE FOR SERVICE $100. SERVED AUG-05-2020, PERSONAL SERVICE AS TO DEFENDANT POPLIN, KATIE

SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF OCT-28-2020 - JUDGMENT. PLAINTIFF JEAN TSAI IS PRESENT. DEFENDANT KATIE POPLIN IS NOT PRESENT. PLAINTIFF EXHIBITS ARE REVIEWED AND RETURNED IN OPEN COURT. COMMISSIONER PANG LY; CLERK: W. TRUPEK. NOT REPORTED.(506)

THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF TSAI, JEAN RECOVER FROM DEFENDANT POPLIN, KATIE $5,689.00 PRINCIPAL, $175.00 COSTS, TOTAL JUDGMENT $5,864.00, PLAINTIFF PRESENTED DEFENDANT'S HANDWRITTEN PROMISSORY NOTE AGREEING TO PAY $5689.00 FOR RECEIVED SERVICES. STAY OF EXECUTION 30 DAYS NO EXHIBITS FILED
